acceptance: Decision gate: the owner decides, path by path, whether to ignore tmp/, output/, results/ and *.log, because they may hold output the owner wants Git to show. The recommendation is to ignore the five tool-cache directories (.mypy_cache/, .ty_cache/, .serena/, .cursor/, .playwright-mcp/) without further discussion. The decision is recorded on this item before any edit.
Each path the owner chose to ignore is added to .gitignore, and git check-ignore --no-index confirms it; each path left out has its reason recorded here.
git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard is empty after the change, so no tracked file becomes ignored.

Guardrails: ignoring belongs in .gitignore only. No allowlist or exemption is added to scripts/check_primary_clone_clean.sh, and the check's coverage of tracked and untracked files is not reduced. No path that holds source, docs or test fixtures is ignored.
description: Since PR #4265 (merged as 04929364fb), a new untracked file in the primary clone that .gitignore does not cover fails make agent-write-preflight for every session whose snapshot was taken earlier, until the file is removed or the session re-records its snapshot with BENCHBOX_PRIMARY_SNAPSHOT_REFRESH=1. On 2026-11-17, git check-ignore --no-index showed these paths are not ignored, and no tracked file lives under any of them: .mypy_cache/, .ty_cache/, .serena/, .cursor/, .playwright-mcp/, tmp/, output/, results/ and *.log. Type checkers, MCP servers, editors and ad-hoc runs create them. None exist in the primary clone today, and the live check reports nothing, so this is a latent false failure, not a current one.
